Name: Pride In The Valley
Author: sapphicsaph
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Tk5O5fE.png[/img]
PITV is a mod dedicated to celebrating the voices, culture and rights of everyone on the LGBTQ+ spectrum.

[b]So far, it features[/b]:
[list]
[*] A passive pride festival that occurs in the Community Center on Summer 15, Summer 16, and Summer 17. At the festival, there are shops, decorations, and unique dialogues for all vanilla NPCs, with ample space for custom NPCs to visit.
[*]A newsletter that the farmer will receive throughout the Summer season, featuring stories, advice and writings from various custom NPCs, curated by a (potential future) NPC with a unique pseudonym.
[*]2 events that will occur in Summer, with more to come!
[*]4 sets of Conversation Topics triggered throughout the year, during which the townies will be saying some gay things.
[*]8 quests by the townies with their own unique stories that hint at various relationships and crushes around the valley.
[*]9 custom pride-themed items and a special cooking recipe, complete with gift tastes.
[/list]
A new save is recommended, but not at all required to install PITV.[img]https://i.imgur.com/5ezJCNG.png[/img]PITV has [b]no known mod incompatibilities[/b], as it only [i]adds [/i]new content instead of changing existing content!

Having the following mods will enhance your Pride Festival experience:
[list]
[*]Creative Differences
[*]Diverse Stardew Valley
[*]Jorts & Jean
[*]Nora The Herpatologist
[*]Ridgeside Village
[*]Visit Mount Vapius
[/list]
[b]NOTE TO MOD AUTHORS[/b]: You can add gift tastes, conversation topic dialogue lines, [url=https://forms.gle/TUAXYXoXdT83chSi6]newsletter write-ins[/url], and festival positions for custom NPCs!

[b]NOTE TO TRANSLATORS[/b]: Please feel free to upload Pride In The Valley as a translated mod, just let me know you plan to do so first!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/05EOFxC.png[/img]
[b]skellady[/b], for the creation and design of the Pride Festival map.

[b]brighterbats[/b], for permission to use the adorable [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12987]Pride Flags[/url] featured in the Pride Festival map.
[b]katreaux[/b], for permission to use the stunning [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20052]Pride[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20045]Arches[/url] featured in the Pride Festival map.
[b]Vinilla[/b], for permission to use the beautiful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16863]Pride Rugs[/url] featured in the Pride Festival map.

[b]Lumisteria[/b], for offering compatibility with VMV by adding a shop to the Pride Festival.
[b]tiakall[/b], for offering compatibility with RSV by providing NPC dialogue for the Pride Festival.

With any questions, comments, or concerns, please contact me on Discord at sapphicsaph.
